description: This file is a shell script for testing the 'git worktree add' functionality within a Git project. It includes setup routines, multiple test cases for various scenarios, and helper functions to validate behavior related to worktree addition, branch tracking, and hooks.

methods.name: test_branch_upstream
methods.description: Checks if a branch 'refs/heads/$3' in a given remote '$2' is set to pull from a specified remote, ensuring upstream configuration is correct.

methods.name: setup_remote_repo
methods.description: Initializes a remote repository with specific branches and commits, then sets up a local repository with appropriate remotes and fetches.

methods.name: test_dwim_orphan
methods.description: Performs comprehensive tests to verify the behavior of the 'git worktree add' command when inferring orphan branches ('--orphan'), including handling of errors, warnings, and various options.

methods.name: post_checkout_hook
methods.description: Sets up a post-checkout hook in a given repository or worktree, which logs information to a file for verification during tests.
